name: Melotap
summary:
Melotap is a calm rhythm game built around beautiful melodies instead of fast reflexes.

Play through a collection of more than 80 carefully arranged classical and folk pieces, with new tracks added regularly. Every level is handcrafted so the notes feel natural under your fingers, making it feel a little like you're actually playing the music.

The game keeps things simple. Clean visuals, hand-drawn artwork, and no unnecessary distractions. It's something you can pick up for a few minutes to relax, or spend longer trying to perfect a piece.

Melotap isn't about chasing high scores as much as getting into the music. It's calm, a little meditative, and just challenging enough to keep you focused.
